hero.tagline: An elegant template for your wedding celebration.
hero.description: Replace this copy with your story, event information, and every detail your guests need before the big day.

about.title: Our Story
about.experienceTitle: Introduce your celebration with a personal message
about.experienceText1: Use this section to share how you met, what this day means to you, or any short welcome note for your guests.
about.experienceText2: It also works well for travel notes, dress code, accommodation tips, or other important information.

story.title: Your story
story.description: Add a warm and personal summary of your relationship.

date.title: The date
date.description: Make it clear when the ceremony starts and when the celebration begins.

place.title: The place
place.description: Include the location, useful references, and transport options.

services.title: Day Details
services.subtitle: Three simple blocks to organize the most important event information.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: Use this space for your welcome note, accommodation details, transfers, or guest recommendations.

moments.title: Special Moments
moments.description: Highlight the ceremony, cocktail hour, photos, gifts, or any meaningful moment you want guests to remember.

party.title: Celebration
party.description: Explain the party, music, dinner, after party, or any other plan for the day.

process.title: Event Schedule
process.subtitle: A clear format for presenting the flow of the big day.
process.step1Description: Share arrival time, ceremony start time, and any important instructions here.
process.step2Description: Add timing for drinks, dinner, speeches, or any special surprises.
process.step3Description: Wrap up the schedule with dancing, open bar, after party, or the planned finish time.
process.communicationDesc: Use this block for transport, dress code, weather, or practical reminders.
process.availabilityDesc: Perfect for allergies, kids, accommodation, parking, or any helpful information.

contact.title: RSVP
contact.subtitle: Use this form as a base for collecting confirmations before the event.
contact.name: Name
contact.messagePlaceholder: Dietary restrictions, questions, or special notes
contact.privacy: This form is only a template. Connect it to your backend or RSVP service before publishing.
contact.validationMessage: Please complete name, email, and message before sending.
contact.successMessage: The frontend template works. Connect your real RSVP flow here.
contact.errorMessage: Review the form integration before publishing the site.
contact.templateNoticeTitle: No real data or embedded map
contact.templateNoticeText: This block replaces the previous personal information. Add your map, contact details, and final content when ready.

footer.description: Base template for a wedding website with story, details, schedule, and RSVP.
footer.notesText: Replace every placeholder with your own details before publishing.
footer.templateHint: This version no longer includes names, photos, or details from the original project.

logo.ariaLabel: Sample logo for a wedding website

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.message: This template uses basic cookies to remember visitor preferences.
